{
  "name": "divramod-subagent-context",
  "displayName": "Subagent Context",
  "version": "0.1.1",
  "description": "A Claude Code mod: a live pane of every subagent of the session with its model, effort, context fill, peak and compactions.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Arvid Petermann",
    "url": "https://github.com/divramod"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/divramod/divramod-claude-code-mods",
  "repository": "https://github.com/divramod/divramod-claude-code-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code-mod",
    "subagents",
    "context",
    "pane"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "window": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subagent context window",
      "description": "The window a subagent's peak is counted against: auto takes this session's window",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "200k",
        "1m"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "warn_percent": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Warn at %",
      "description": "A subagent's row turns yellow from this share of its window",
      "min": 1,
      "max": 100,
      "default": 30
    },
    "alert_percent": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Alert at %",
      "description": "A subagent's row turns red from this share of its window",
      "min": 1,
      "max": 100,
      "default": 35
    }
  }
}
